verdict.rationale: Token2 ships its own bulk-enrollment tool (fido2_bulkenroll_entraid). It registers multiple FIDO2 security keys in Microsoft Entra ID through the Provisioning Graph API, can set random PINs, and logs results. That gives one real multi-item workflow, but bulk operations across other item types (passkeys, PINs, keys on many devices) are not shown. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond Entra ID enrollment, documented batch semantics or scale limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: This tool streamlines the process of registering FIDO2 security keys in Microsoft Entra ID by leveraging the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API. It supports features like setting random PINs, managing keys, and logging results
